queries.result: The first-party results again identified the City of Charlotte parcel MapServer, Mecklenburg County GIS, Polaris, and the county open-mapping portal. No separate non-English local cadastral custodian was indicated; English is the service language used by the U.S. local custodians.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: City of Charlotte GIS / Charlotte-Mecklenburg GIS
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Charlotte and Mecklenburg County parcel layer; metadata extent covers the Mecklenburg area
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Layer is a polygon Feature Layer, supports JSON/geoJSON/PBF, has maxRecordCount 3000, and declares Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere (WKID 102100/3857). Fields include OBJECTID, NC_PIN, and PID; the retained identity uses NC_PIN.
Official county parcel service lead; direct anonymous requests from this environment returned HTTP 403, so it was not used for the retained sample.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: County GIS apps and public data resources

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Returned layer metadata: polygon geometry, extent, WKID 102100/3857, supported query formats JSON/geoJSON/PBF, maxRecordCount 3000, and native identity candidate fields OBJECTID/NC_PIN/PID.
Exact WUP point query returned one polygon feature. Requested only OBJECTID, NC_PIN, PID and geometry; output was GeoJSON in EPSG:4326. The exact point was not shifted.
Official county endpoint denied anonymous metadata retrieval from this environment. No login, token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was attempted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City of Charlotte parcel MapServer and Mecklenburg County parcel publications; the City service metadata and item extent indicate Mecklenburg-area coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One exact-point parcel response plus official layer metadata; not a citywide feature inventory.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: City of Charlotte GIS and Mecklenburg County GIS parcel custodians are evidenced.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: One returned Polygon was retained unchanged from the successful GeoJSON response.
qualityAssessment.crs: Service metadata declares WKID 102100/3857; query requested outSR=4326 and returned longitude/latitude GeoJSON coordinates.
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: NC_PIN is the preferred stable native parcel identity candidate because it is a named native parcel identifier field; OBJECTID and PID were observed but not retained in the sample.
